title: VIX futures and options January 2028 expiration (SOQ settlement) — the settlement whose date is the first in this class read off a published 2028 calendar rather than derived from statute
source: EST: RULE-DERIVED, with both of the rule's holiday legs checked against a PUBLISHED PRIMARY THAT REACHES 2028 — which no prior ledger in this class had. Cboe's VX contract specification, cboe.com/tradable_products/vix/vix_futures/specifications/, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 461,361 bytes, redirect followed): 'The final settlement date for a contract with the "VX" ticker symbol is on the Wednesday that is 30 days prior to the third Friday of the calendar month immediately following the month in which the contract expires', and 'If that Wednesday or the Friday that is 30 days following that Wednesday is a Cboe Options holiday, the final settlement date for the contract shall be on the business day immediately preceding that Wednesday.' Applied to the January 2028 contract: third Friday of February 2028 = Friday 2028-02-18, minus 30 days = Wednesday 2028-01-19. NEITHER LEG IS A HOLIDAY, AND THAT IS NOW PUBLISHER-CONFIRMED RATHER THAN COMPUTED: nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 109,180 bytes), carries a full 2028 column — MLK 'Monday, January 17', Washington's Birthday 'Monday, February 21', Good Friday 'Friday, April 14', and New Year's Day rendered as an em-dash with the verbatim footnote 'Because the holiday falls on Saturday, January 1, 2028, no New Year's Day holiday is observed.' Nothing in that table falls on 2028-01-19 or 2028-02-18, so the clause does not fire and the date is the unadjusted Wednesday. THE UNDERLYING RULE WAS RE-VALIDATED FROM SCRATCH by an independently written engine: 217 of 218 rule-derived monthly settlements 2008-07 -> 2026-08 are present in cdn.cboe.com/api/global/us_indices/daily_prices/VRO_History.csv (fetched direct 2026-09-09, HTTP 200, 26,597 bytes, 1,268 rows), the sole absentee 2013-05-22 carrying no May-2013 row at any date — reproducing all four sibling implementations exactly. The February 2028 sibling's 296-of-296 holiday-clause result was ALSO reproduced independently, but only after a defect in this session's statute-derived holiday set was found and corrected (see notes). Filed estimate on three counts, none of them the arithmetic: no Cboe or OCC surface names a 2028 contract; cdn.cboe.com/data/us/futures/market_statistics/historical_data/VX/VX_2028-01-19.csv returns 403 while the control VX_2027-05-18.csv returns 200 on the same endpoint in the same run; and market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy is satisfied by OCC: only once a published expiration calendar names the date, which the OIC/OCC file (optionseducation.org/api/expirationcalendar, HTTP 200, 34,871 bytes) does not — it stops at 2027-12-15 and carries no 2028 row. Promotion requires reading a Cboe or OCC primary that reaches 2028, never recomputing the rule. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: CANONICAL, written 2026-09-09 by this id's own never-assessed initial research after reading the one proposal that existed for it, proposals/vix-expiration-2028-01-19.from-mlk-market-closure-2028-01-17.json (#1717 procedure). That proposal's date, its 28-day January-to-February gap, and its overlap finding are all CONFIRMED; two of its framings are sharpened and one sibling headline is superseded. (1) THE MLK 'UNCOVERED GAP' REGULARITY IS NOT ABOUT MLK. mlk-market-closure-2027-01-18.md measured MLK landing in an uncovered hole between two 30-day strips at 23 of 53 years (43.4%), 1998-2050, and named the 35-day-consecutive-third-Friday mechanism beside it as a separate fact. This session proves the two are THE SAME SET, not merely correlated: over 1990-2300 the year set 'MLK uncovered' and the year set 'January is a 35-gap month' are IDENTICAL, 133 of 311 (42.8%), and the 1998-2050 restriction reproduces 23 of 53 exactly. The third Monday is a passenger; the third Friday of January decides everything. The 53-year computation collapses to a one-line test: MLK is uncovered if and only if it falls on January 18, 19 or 20 (equivalently, the third Friday of January falls on the 15th, 16th or 17th). 2028 and 2027 are the two extremes of that test — the third Friday of January 2028 is the 21st, the LATEST it can ever be, against 2027's 15th, the EARLIEST. (2) A STRUCTURAL CLASSIFICATION THAT SUPERSEDES 'FEBRUARY IS THE STRUCTURALLY SAFEST MONTH'. Scoring the full clause over every monthly contract 1990-2300 (3,732 settlements): only THREE of twelve contract months can be displaced with any regularity — March (66 of 311, Good Friday landing on the third Friday of April), May (79 of 311, Juneteenth landing on the third Friday of June) and June (39 of 311, Juneteenth landing on the settlement Wednesday itself) — with February a distant fourth at 4 of 311. NINE OF TWELVE MONTHS ARE 0 OF 311, JANUARY AMONG THEM, and January's immunity has a two-line proof: its settlement Wednesday can only fall 01-16..01-22 and its Friday leg only 02-15..02-21, and the only US market closures that ever reach those ranges are MLK and Washington's Birthday, both always Mondays. Realized data agrees — all four monthly displacements in 2021-2026 are March, March, May and June contracts. So February is not the safest month; it is the fourth-safest, and January is in the permanently-immune class. (3) A HOLIDAY-SET DEFECT, FOUND BY THE TAPE AND CONFIRMED BY THE PUBLISHER. This session's first-pass statute-derived holiday engine predicted 14 displacements over the February sibling's 2021-2026 window, one more than the 13 that ledger reports: a false positive at settlement Wednesday 2021-12-01, whose Friday leg 2021-12-31 the engine had marked a holiday by observing a Saturday New Year's Day backward onto the preceding Friday. VRO_History.csv refutes it (a settlement on Wednesday 2021-12-01, none on Tuesday 2021-11-30), and NYSE's own 2028 footnote states the governing rule in words. Corrected, the engine reproduces 296 of 296 and 13-for-13 exactly. THAT IS AN INDEPENDENT REPRODUCTION OF THE SIBLING'S LOAD-BEARING RESULT FROM A SEPARATELY WRITTEN ENGINE, plus the specific defect any future implementation must not have. (4) THIS SETTLEMENT SITS INSIDE THE FOMC COMMUNICATIONS BLACKOUT, as the proposer said: fomc-blackout-start-2028-01-15 (estimate) runs 2028-01-15 -> 2028-01-27, so the SOQ prints on a morning when no Fed official may speak, and the meeting itself (fomc-2028-01-26, estimate) is seven days after settlement rather than before it. (5) THE 30-DAY REFERENCE WINDOW 2028-01-19 -> 2028-02-18 IS CLOSURE-FREE: 23 trading sessions, zero holidays, because MLK 2028-01-17 falls two days before the window opens and Washington's Birthday 2028-02-21 falls three days after it closes. Only 48 of 111 January windows 1990-2100 are closure-free (48 contain Washington's Birthday, 15 contain MLK), so this is the minority case and it is the same 28-gap structure that covers MLK, seen from the other side. NOTHING TRADEABLE IS CLAIMED. symbols is empty, impact low matches every other vix-expiration-* entry, no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is settlement-keyed or calendar-keyed (trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md re-grepped this session for opex|expiration|witching|volatility settlement|SOQ: zero hits in both), and every frequency above is calendar arithmetic rather than a market measurement. Estimate widens caution and licenses no entry.
